notes: The app now remembers which kinds of video your box's built-in player cannot handle. The first time a stream needs the backup player it works as before, but from then on any similar stream skips straight to the one that works instead of spending 10-12 seconds figuring it out again. It re-checks periodically, so nothing gets written off permanently, and it can never hide a stream - it only picks which player to use. Open the info panel while playing to see which one is active.
